entities.name: Rootha Squallheart
entities.description: An orc Prismari student with wild magic, from a famous family of artist-mages, who cannot finish her projects and struggles with her temper.

entities.name: Uvilda
entities.description: The finned Dean of Perfection at Prismari College, a controlled and cool-toned mage who pressures Rootha to turn in a project.

entities.name: Nassari
entities.description: A fiery efreet and Dean of Expression at Prismari who sees wild magic in Rootha and becomes her advisor.

entities.name: Felisa Fang
entities.description: A vampire of the Silverquill college and a Vainglory, who uses encouragement magic on her former friend Rootha.

entities.name: Samara Squallheart
entities.description: Rootha's mother, a lauded artist-mage of ice and water sculptures whose waterfall stands on Opus Walk.

entities.name: Tomlin
entities.description: Rootha's youngest brother, whom she hurt with her magic as a child.

entities.name: Prismari College
entities.description: The Strixhaven college of expressive arcane art.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university campus where the story is set.

entities.name: Opus Walk
entities.description: A campus walk lined with art projects left behind by graduates, including Samara's waterfall.

entities.name: Furygale
entities.description: A dark graveyard of abandoned projects and half-cast spells at the edge of Prismari's campus, where honor duels happen.

entities.name: Conjurot Hall
entities.description: The hall with Nassari's high office, apartments and workshop.

entities.name: Bow's End
entities.description: A pub where Rootha and Felisa once spent a night.

events.summary: Rootha is called into the Dean of Perfection's office and distracted by a song stuck in her head.
events.quote: I've got a song stuck in my head.

events.summary: Uvilda reprimands Rootha for being the only student to have not applied for a critique, having finished nothing.
events.quote: You are the only student who hasn't yet applied for a critique

events.summary: Uvilda brings up Rootha's mother, which angers Rootha.
events.quote: Your mother was an incredibly talented and delicate caster.

events.summary: Uvilda gives Rootha a day to bring a finished project or lose her place.
events.quote: Or I'm afraid I can no longer guarantee a place for you at Prismari college.

events.summary: Dean Nassari emerges from a candle flame and teases Rootha outside the office.
events.quote: Do you make it a habit to lurk in candle flames during student critiques?

events.summary: Nassari offers Rootha less naggingly tiresome advice and tells her there is wild magic in her, triggering a memory.
events.quote: There's wild magic in you.

events.summary: Rootha realizes the song stuck in her head is one her mother used to sing as she painted (flashback).
events.quote: My mother used to sing it to herself as she worked.

events.summary: In her studio, Rootha examines her frozen-water sculpture and decides it is her best bet for the critique.
events.quote: I filled a bucket with water and poured it onto the studio floor, freezing it as it splashed back up at me.

events.summary: Felisa Fang arrives at Rootha's studio door.
events.quote: I know you're in there, Rooth. I can sense the melancholia.

events.summary: Felisa uses flattering Vainglory magic on Rootha.
events.quote: Not as pretty as you, though.

events.summary: Rootha accuses Felisa of using magic on her and sends her away.
events.quote: Don't use magic on me.

events.summary: Rootha smashes her sculpture in anger.
events.quote: My sculpture chimes out like a thousand tiny bells as I smash it to pieces on the studio floor.

events.summary: Drunk and angry, Rootha goes to her mother's endless waterfall on Opus Walk and considers destroying it.
events.quote: Her greatest creation: an endless waterfall pouring out of nothing and disappearing back into nowhere.

events.summary: Nassari stops Rootha with a cord of flame and heals her scalded wrist.
events.quote: A slender cord of flame entwines my wrist, more vapor than fire.

events.summary: Nassari suggests Uvilda is courting the Squallhearts' donations, and Rootha realizes her acceptance may have rested on her mother's fame.
events.quote: Maybe it's less your success she's courting, and more the notice of an interested party.

events.summary: Nassari confides they never liked Rootha's mother.
events.quote: I never liked your mother.

events.summary: Nassari tells Rootha her ordered magic does not suit her, since she feels like the potential before an earthquake.
events.quote: That's what you feel like to me.

events.summary: Rootha tells Nassari how she hurt her little brother as a child and was shunned (flashback).
events.quote: I wanted to hurt him, and I did.

events.summary: Rootha admits she could have killed her brother and enjoyed it.
events.quote: I could have killed my brother, and I enjoyed it!

events.summary: Goaded by Nassari, Rootha blasts a raw burst of wild magic at them.
events.quote: Power bursts hard and blazing from my diaphragm, a hot gout of magic that comes out in a shout.

events.summary: Nassari catches the blast between their palms and siphons it into Furygale.
events.quote: They spring backward into the air and catch my magic between their palms.

events.summary: Nassari tells Rootha she will not be thrown out of Prismari.
events.quote: I'm not going to throw you out of Prismari, Rootha Squallheart.

events.summary: Rootha touches the hanging magic and hears her mother's song within it.
events.quote: My mother's song rings in my ears when I touch the magic.

events.summary: Nassari takes over as Rootha's advisor and declares she passes.
events.quote: Uvilda isn't your advisor anymore. I am. And I say you pass.

events.summary: Nassari tells Rootha she is one of theirs and that they will not let her magic burn away.
events.quote: The magic inside you is what I am made of, body and soul.

relations.note: Nassari takes over as Rootha's advisor.
relations.quote: Uvilda isn't your advisor anymore. I am.
I told her a gilded picture of growing up with Samara Squallheart

relations.quote: I could have killed my brother, and I enjoyed it!
I want to enable you to do the best work you can here at Prismari College.

Former friends who met at a pub and drifted apart.
relations.quote: we've barely spoken since we chose our colleges
